description: Source file defining functions and constants for building workspace skill command specifications, including sanitization, deduplication, and filtering of skills and bundle commands.

methods.name: debugSkillCommandOnce
methods.description: Logs a debug message once per message key to avoid duplicate logs.

methods.name: sanitizeSkillCommandName
methods.description: Normalizes and trims a raw skill name to a sanitized command name.

methods.name: resolveUniqueSkillCommandName
methods.description: Ensures a skill command name is unique within a set by appending suffixes if necessary.
